fields.statement: Change set 01M6XV4 (plan runs exceed rhiza.daemon.maxRuns): the root cause found is that each project's ship picks, continuations and queued starts count only live runs, not a plan request's start that has not journaled yet (up to daemonStartGrace, 1m), while the round-robin share already assumed it holds a slot; at 13:16:15 a request's plan run started and at 13:16:36 two ship runs started before it journaled. Should plan runs share the machine-wide maxRuns, or get their own cap? / The daemon's own resume of an interrupted run (daemon.Resumable) starts without any slot check and is not counted by later picks in the same poll. Should it count against maxRuns? / A milestone request's plan run currently starts at once whether or not a slot is free (owner decision milestone-interview-starts-at-once, an interactive owner session). Keep that exception? / How should rhiza health show live runs against the cap?
